meta.title: eRFX Auction stage, no clause mandatory: the vendor accepts both clauses
gaps: Directly verify on the buyer side that both clauses are recorded as accepted after the vendor submits the bid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly verify on the buyer side that both clauses are recorded as accepted after the vendor submits the bid.

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Choose an Auction pricing template before adding the item.
Add the required auction line item.
Complete the Auction pricing sheet.

args.goal: On the Auction stage, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", leave both clause modes set to None, leave "Mark all Terms & Conditions mandatory" unticked, click Done, and stop on the Auction create screen.

steps.note: Configure the two event/stage clauses with no mandatory requirement.
Commit the 30-minute schedule.
Invite one QA test vendor for Vendor A.
Publish the configured auction event.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the supplier portal in the separate vendor session.
Open the event's Auction pricing round as the vendor.
Verify the first clause is visible to the vendor.
Verify the second clause is visible to the vendor.
Accept the first clause.
Accept the second clause.
Submit the vendor quote at 100 for every line.
Confirm the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer console.
Confirm the buyer sees the vendor response on the Auction stage.
